hero.title: Moral Merry High School
hero.subtitle: Lighted to Lighten
hero.text: Values-based education from Nursery to Class 10 in the heart of Masab Tank, Hyderabad.

journey.heading: Our Journey
journey.text: Since 1980, Moral Merry High School has grown from a small community school into a trusted name in Masab Tank, Hyderabad. Our commitment to moral values, discipline and academic excellence has stayed unwavering through decades of growth.

campus.subtitle: Learning, celebrating and growing together every day

items.caption: Yoga and meditation for a calm, focused mind

items.title: Academic Excellence
items.text: A balanced curriculum from Nursery to Class 10, with smart classes and weekly assessments.

items.title: Sports & Fitness
items.text: Coaching in cricket, football, basketball and athletics, plus an annual sports meet.

items.title: Arts & Culture
items.text: Music, dance, drama, art and fancy-dress events that build confidence.

items.title: Yoga & Meditation
items.text: Regular yoga and meditation sessions help students stay calm and focused.

items.text: Daily speaking practice, with awards for excellent English communication.

items.title: Science Exhibitions
items.text: An annual science fair where students build and present their own projects.

items.question: Is this the official website of Moral Merry School?
items.answer: Yes. moralmerry.in is the official website of Moral Merry High School, also known as Moral Merry School, in MG Nagar, Owaisi Pura, Masab Tank, Hyderabad. Information here comes directly from the school.

items.question: Where is Moral Merry High School located?
items.answer: 10-4-13/11/A/5/1, MG Nagar, Owaisi Pura, Masab Tank, Hyderabad, Telangana 500028. Use the Contact page for directions on Google Maps.

items.question: Which classes does the school offer?
items.answer: Nursery to Class 10, following the Telangana State Board (SSC) syllabus. The school is recognised by the Government of Telangana.

items.question: What are the school timings?
items.answer: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

items.question: When was Moral Merry School established?
items.answer: The school was established in 1980 and has served families in Masab Tank and nearby areas of Hyderabad for over 45 years.

items.question: How can I get admission?
items.answer: Admissions are open for Nursery to Class 10. Visit the school office, call +91 91602 15224, or send an enquiry from the Contact page.

items.question: What are the school fees?
items.answer: Fees are kept affordable. See the fee structure on the Admissions page, or contact the school office for the latest fees.

items.question: Who is the principal?
items.answer: Mr. Abdul Akbar Khan is the principal of Moral Merry High School.
